reason: I endorse this one change. I read amendment/change.json and the ELM-ADOPT-030 entry in candidates-v3.json. The v3 supported-disabled-action THEN now requires native AT to expose unavailable state and 'any reason required by the frozen per-surface policy', which matches the v2 EARS wording exactly. The v2 THEN demanded a reason in every case, which the EARS and guardrails ('no universal requirement', GTK vs Windows/APG differences) do not support, so the change removes an unsupported scenario claim. The safety properties are unchanged: stable position, an exposed unavailable state, and no dispatch through pointer, keyboard or AT activation. The all-disabled-and-focus-retirement scenario is byte-identical to v2 in change.json. I did not diff the other 29 contracts myself; I rely on the coordinator's statement that they are unchanged. My v2 votes carry forward as cast: 29 accept as guarded draft contracts and ELM-ADOPT-015 defer as a conditional deferred draft. I cannot compute SHA-256 in this session, so both hashes above are taken from the request, not independently verified. This is my position only, not a claim of consensus. It implies no native acceptance, baseline expansion or product selection. I made no source, config or GUI edits and spawned no agents.
